newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Perdigao Q3 net 1.8 mln reais.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Perdigao Q3 net 1.8 mln reais.

text.p: Brazil poultry processor Perdigao issued the following figures on its 1996 third quarter results.
NOTE: All figures in Brazilian reais and adjusted for inflation.
No per share figures or comparative figures were provided.
Perdigao said in a statement its nine-month profit and sales totalled 401,000 reais and 711.7 million reais, respectively.
Perdigao's third quarter results benefited from steady raw material prices and a slight increase in the price of its products, it said.

The company also said exports rose 41.3 percent to 37,500 tonnes in the third quarter over a year ago due to higher international demand and growing prices abroad. Sales for international markets totalled 73.3 million reais out of a total sales of 258.1 million reais between July and September, it added.
According to Perdigao President Nildemar Secches, the company expects demand to continue rising in the last quarter of the year with an increase in domestic prices.
